title: Isandro and the Portrait
author: Sebastian Ashgrove
blurb: Sable Halloran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
